Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, docs, activities, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno from parent molecule_dictionary and molregno on child molecule_dictionary. Join compound_structures on child molregno. Join compound_records on child molregno. Join docs on compound_records doc_id. Join activities on compound_records record_id. Join assays on activities assay_id. Join target_dictionary on assays tid. Filter parent molecule_dictionary chembl_id to CHEMBL1173655. Filter activities standard_type to IC50. Filter activities standard_units to nM. Filter target_dictionary chembl_id to CHEMBL203. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
